hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The linked list has an even number of nodes paired sequentially.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: For each pair of nodes (even, odd), award a point to Even if even value is greater or Odd if odd value is greater.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Traverse the list two nodes at a time, comparing curr.val with curr.next.val. Tally points and return Even, Odd, or Tie.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in linked list
complexity.notes: Single pass over linked list jumping two nodes each step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Traverse linked list with step of 2 without allocating auxiliary memory.
